description.value: Tofino Swell Lodge is a three-generation family-run guest house on Olsen Road, operating since 1984, with seven private rooms featuring views of Clayoquot Sound. Guests share a communal living and kitchen area designed for socializing with fellow travellers. The lodge emphasizes immersive coastal experiences including fishing, natural hot springs, and scenic boat tours.
